notes.title: Skippable Battles
notes.content:
[h3]A new feature has been added and the game balance has been improved.[/h3]

[h3]FEATURES:[/h3]
Added an option to skip battles after defeat. This option is not just a technical skip of the battle, but part of the narrative component and affects the story.

[h3]BALANCE:[/h3]
The number of orbs for some enemy spells has been reduced.

notes.title: ALL IS READY!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Good news, everyone![/b][/h3]

There has been no news for a long time, but now there is some, and it is good.

The game is 100% ready and awaiting approval from Valve, which means it will be out very soon (in about 2-5 days) if there are no issues with the approval.

In addition, I want to thank all the Steam curators who showed interest in the game and have already played it and left their reviews. Thank you very much! I am very glad that you liked it. I am also looking forward to the reviews from players when the game is released.

Thank you for your attention, and be ready for the game's release at any moment!

Cheers,
Meepower

notes.title: Update on the Release of "The Concentration of Lust"
notes.content:
Hello dear friends,

I have some important news regarding the release of "The Concentration of Lust." 
While the game is 99% ready, I have encountered a delicate issue with the artist that requires a bit more time to resolve. This unexpected challenge has unfortunately delayed my initial release date.

I apologize for this delay and I'm working diligently to ensure that I deliver the highest quality experience possible.

In the meantime, I ask you to stay tuned and add "The Concentration of Lust" to your wishlist to be the first to know about the game's release. The game is coming soon!

In addition, I want to say that the game will have a significant discount in the first week after release. I'm confident it will be worth the wait and can't wait for you to experience the final product.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

Cheers,
Meepower
